writePathWhyNestedLoopCannotOccur.poisonCause: MATERIALIZED CTE scans have no index. Join quals were only <= >= IS NOT NULL and ST_Intersects. PostgreSQL Hash Join requires equality in hashclauses. The method set was Nested Loop only. That is why the live plan was Nested Loop of two CTE scans, cost 1.06e10.
writePathWhyNestedLoopCannotOccur.equality: p.county_fips = c.county_fips is an equality. Hash Join enters the method set. Cities (small, inlined) are the hash build; parcels_six (MATERIALIZED, ~1,043,462) is the probe. Nested Loop without an index stays the 1.06e10 path and loses the cost comparison.
writePathWhyNestedLoopCannotOccur.notMaterializedBind: cities_ok AS NOT MATERIALIZED is a bind, not a hint. EXPLAIN cannot emit CTE Scan on cities or CTE Scan on cities_ok. isMillionRowCteNestedLoop requires that city CTE Scan as conjunct three. The named poison shape is unrepresentable even if a small Nested Loop remains inside the hash build (city x 6 counties).
